claycode.summary: WP04/WP11/WP12 diagnostics should expose stable namespaced rule identity and a versioned occurrence fingerprint separate from message/spans/run instance; integrate without new surface syntax.

harness.summary: H1/H2 differential failure matching should compare stable semantic diagnostic fingerprints where available rather than raw backend text/locations; preserve backend/runtime provenance separately.

frank.summary: FRANK component/handoff receipts can gain causal failure localization from stable diagnostics, but diagnostic identity is observability metadata and not execution authority or cognitive evidence.

unifieddb.summary: If diagnostics are persisted/queryable, store rule identity/fingerprint/provenance/spans separately; semantic/logical diagnostic identity does not imply physical store merge.

claygraph.summary: No ClayGraph semantic change required. Diagnostic records may later be related/provenance-linked without turning graph connectivity into evidence strength.

gwt.summary: No direct change to workspace/recurrence mechanisms. Diagnostics may aid executable causal debugging only.

emergenz.summary: No emergence claim follows. Stable diagnostics are instrumentation quality, not evidence of consciousness or causal emergence.

hyperposition.summary: No topology/coupling semantic change required. Diagnostic fingerprints should not encode incidental physical topology unless a rule explicitly diagnoses it.

clayresearch.summary: Treat diagnostic identity as a cross-cutting observability/provenance primitive candidate; test whether it reduces false novelty/false equivalence in research and implementation receipts without becoming a new semantic authority plane.

anti_echo: FRANK/Harness/ClayCode agreement remains shared-ancestry evidence where it reuses common contracts. Independent support comes only from separate standards/compiler behavior and discriminating execution, and even that is precedent rather than proof of ClayCode correctness.
